plan.notes: Source: '2020-21 Computer Science Checklist' (2-page PDF), page 2 titled '2020-21 Major B.S. in Computer Science Program Sample Four-Year Plan'. Degree type confirmed as B.S. (not B.A.) from that page header. Document retrieved 2026-09-30 from Marian University's own dev.marian.edu staging server at https://dev.marian.edu/_documents/bachelor/computer-science-plan.pdf — the same document previously published at www.marian.edu/_documents/bachelor/computer-science-plan.pdf, which now returns the site 404 page (verified by both browser fetch and curl 2026-09-30; the server answers 200 with the 404-page body). No newer official CS sample four-year plan was found: the current CS program page (marian.edu/academics/programs/bachelors/indianapolis/computer-science) publishes no downloadable plan, and current 2025-26 checklists/four-year plans on marian.edu cover other programs (e.g., B.S. Computer Engineering, A.S. Information Technology), not Computer Science. Transcription method: PDF text extraction (pypdf) of page 2 cross-checked against the search-engine cached rendering of the 2019 revision of the same plan; term totals and course codes verified line by line. Caveats: (1) This is a 2020-21 document (its own page 2 header) — the catalog year recorded is the document's stated year, not a current catalog. (2) CST 250 Design and Analysis of Algorithms is 3 credits in the sample plan (used here; matches the printed Spring Year 2 total of 15); the checklist page 1 header lists it at 4 credits — the sample-plan value was used and the term-total arithmetic verified (sum = 128). (3) The plan publishes no course-to-course prerequisites, so all prereq lists are empty rather than invented; minimum grade C notations in the source are recorded in choice_note fields, not as new fields. (4) The sequence's published cumulative total is 128 credits, equal to Marian's published 128-credit minimum for the bachelor's degree. Plan is 'only a sample and will vary by student and course availability' per the source; requires minimum 2.0 cumulative and 2.0 major GPA. Course titles come from the checklist page 1 where given; verbatim (e.g., 'PHL 130 Human Nature & Person'; 'CST 150/171 Intro or Procedural Programming').
